scope: Source-backed display names for non-UTF8 TrueType/Type0 font names, and empty Unicode Cc control outlines. Includes separately qualified native line-pitch component. No new recognition or whole-document fidelity claim.
implementation: Valid declared UTF8 display names retain precedence. Fallback only uses matching Font/Descriptor raw names, resolved FontFile2 generation and consistent bounded ASCII PostScript name ID6 records. No encoding guessing, dependency or font-byte rewrite.

Existing 8MiB font limits, metadata/decompression budgets and embedding permission validation remain. Empty-outline validation accepts Unicode whitespace or Cc controls; visible/combining/format characters remain checked.
